text:
Samir: Quick shoutout to Ops (Jun + Priya) for the 2am kernel patch and the surprise cookie drop [0m[0m🍪 — saved our client demo.
Jun: haha thanks! it was a team hustle, caffeine + cookies combo. :partyparrot: 
Elena: HUGE kudos. Jun stayed on the call till 3am. Can we add them to the physical "Thank-You Ticker" on the whiteboard? ❤️
ops-bot: incident note: midnight-kernel-patch completed by Jun & Priya — no customer-facing downtime. :white_check_mark:
Priya: appreciate it y'all! not a solo thing — Marcus ran for chargers, Alex refilled snacks, Nora printed the interim notes. 🙌
Marcus: chargers + duct tape = reliable. ⚡ Also thinking of a tiny sticker-jar next to the ticker for micro-thanks.
Samir: love that. Also, who took the last GF cookie? 😂
Nora: not me. maybe the office snack ninja. 🕵️‍♀️
Priya: quick poll: hand-written thank-you cards or sticker jar? react with :card_index: for cards, :label: for stickers
Jun: :label: stickers. making one that says "Ops Saved My Demo" 🤣
Alex: printing idea: 40 stickers, names + date. I can stick them on the board after lunch.
Marcus: volunteer sign-up: 2 minutes to affix stickers. Alex + Samir?
Samir: in. Also tagging for weekly digest: can we include a 1-line entry "micro-ops-win: kernel patch prevented demo" for visibility in Friday digest?
Elena: adding to digest notes now. GIF to use in the digest: https://giphy.com/gifs/thank-you-team-ops-3o6ZsX81
Samir: thanks everyone — let's keep the sticker tradition going. :trophy:
Elena: extra: leaving a jar of mini cookies in the kitchen labeled "Ops Hero Snacks". please sign the sticker when you take one.
Jun: emoji chain please: :thumbsup: :rocket: :coffee:
